name: mp-sdk
description: 跨平台 JSBridge SDK 工程

scripts.build:android: cd android && gradlew.bat :and_web_library:assembleRelease && cd .. && node scripts/post-build.js android
scripts.build:web: cd vue-web-sdk && npm run build && npm pack && cd .. && node scripts/post-build.js web
scripts.build:all: npm run build:android && npm run build:harmony && npm run build:web
scripts.install:all: npm run install:web-sdk && npm run install:vue-web
